sloka: तां शिलां तु प्रचिक्षेप राक्षसाय महाबलः।बिभेद तां शिलां कुम्भः प्रसन्नैः पञ्चभिः शरैः ।। ६.७६.४३ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ śilāṁ tu pracikṣepa rākṣasāya mahābalaḥ।bibheda tāṁ śilāṁ kumbhaḥ prasannaiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.76.43 ।।

translations.english: The mighty Vanara (Mainda) for his part hurled the rock to crush the Rakshasa. Kumbha attacked him with five sharp arrows and rock got broken.
